resources.string: Ask anything. Task, agent, model, mode and MCPs are under the input; your chats are in the menu on the left.
The agent decides who answers (Claude, Hermes, Goose, OpenClaw, or a model through OpenRouter); the model is the one that agent runs when it takes a choice. The same two pickers are above the chat.
Answers come from the fleet agent gateway (my-ai-api) over the mesh. This app holds no token: the gateway holds the fleet keys.
The fleet\'s assistant: Notebook (answers only from your sources), SI (the router chat) and CGCs (the experts, one chat each). Version %1$s, build %2$s.
Open or create a notebook first (Notebooks tab).
No notebooks yet. Name one above to start adding sources.
Add a file (text, Markdown, HTML, CSV, JSON; from any storage, Drive included)
That file is not readable text, or it is a PDF and the fleet extractor did not answer (it needs the tunnel up). Paste its text as a note.
That page could not be fetched.
This notebook has no sources yet. Add a note, a web page or a file in Sources.
Ask a question: answers come only from this notebook\'s sources, with citations.
